about.title: An Allied Reliability brand, built around rotating equipment.
text: Texas Rotating Equipment is a brand of Allied Reliability, and we support industrial facilities that depend on steam-driven turbines, pumps, gearboxes, bearings, governors and controls.
We work on many brands, including Dresser-Rand, Elliott, Coppus, Moore, Worthington, Turbodyne, Murray and Gimpel.
We stress standardized documentation and proactive updates, so you can see where your repair stands.
